about: Datasheet pin numbering for LCSC parts whose EasyEDA footprint fit and the JLC rotation DB disagree. An entry lets audit.py trust the EasyEDA pad-number fit over the DB rule, but only when (1) the EasyEDA symbol's pin names equal the datasheet's pin functions by number, (2) the KiCad footprint's pad numbers are the datasheet pin numbers, and (3) the fit is unique. Each entry cites the datasheet page it was read from; the PDF is not committed (hash given).
